metrics.budget: Every ordinary turn uses at most 8 rounds and 64 tool records. Transport timeout, no progress and cancellation are covered separately by fixed contracts.
metrics.toolBoundary: No source editing, shell, script or automatic optimization tool is invoked; model edits still require confirmation and unchanged-state checks. Prohibited requests are separately replayed at the public tool/task boundaries.

network: Replay replaces only provider replies. Online never replaces fetch or chatDeepSeek; encrypted DeepSeek credentials and Local State are copied to an isolated temporary profile. Missing credentials or launch failure is blocked/failed, never skipped or counted as passed.
failurePolicy: No automatic retries. Archive each repetition, failed checks, missing observations, inputs, tool outputs, model/settings and reporter failures. Fixes require a new timestamped run; retain previous runs. Never change gates after observing a result.
registrationNote: Version 4 retains all version 3 physics inputs and gates, adds native frozen-input recovery contracts and original T2-11 desktop regression, and rejects source/build drift. Versions 2 and 3 failure runs remain archived; version 3 exposed legacy Worker fault injection and incomplete native solver/mesh checkpoints.
